Name: Qi Fruits Replacements (CP)
Author: KimmJoja
Description:
Replaces the icon, crop, and giant crop of Qi fruits using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

You can select each texture in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].
(To use another mod's retexture or the vanilla texture, select Disable.)



[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]를 통해 치 열매 아이콘, 작물, 거대 작물의 외형을 대체합니다.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿에서 변경할 외형을 선택할 수 있습니다.
(바닐라나 다른 모드의 리텍스처를 사용하려면 비활성화를 선택하세요.)[center]
